title: Seasons and Weather
description: Practise weather words and future forms, then write about your favourite season.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ☀️ It is very ___ in summer, so we swim a lot.
exercises.explanation: We swim in summer because it is hot.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Look at the black clouds. It ___ rain soon.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: It is going to snow tonight.
exercises.explanation: Subject + is going to + base verb.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: In spring, flowers grows in the garden.
answers: In spring, flowers grow in the garden.
exercises.explanation: "Flowers" is plural, so no -s on the verb.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Take an umbrella or you will get wet.
answers: If you don't take an umbrella, you will get wet.
If you do not take an umbrella, you will get wet.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If it ___ tomorrow, we will have a picnic.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Autumn is the season ___ the leaves fall.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: You should wear a warm coat.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: It ___ when we left the house.
exercises.explanation: Use the past continuous for rain that was in progress.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: July is the most hot month of the year.
answers: July is the hottest month of the year.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: It ___ rained all week. I am tired of it!

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Take a hat. It ___ be sunny later.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.explanation: Swap the seasons and change hotter to cooler.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: It was very cold, ___ we stayed at home.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Spring is the best season for flowers.
exercises.explanation: Spring is the best + noun + for + thing.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There isn't ___ snow in my city.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Tomorrow it are going to be windy.
answers: Tomorrow it is going to be windy.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: I think it is going to be warm tomorrow.
answers: I think it will be warm tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: "Will" and "going to" can both give predictions.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: The wind was blowing ___ , so we flew our kites. (strong)
exercises.explanation: Use an adverb to say how the wind blew: strongly.

task.prompt: Write about your favourite season for a class magazine.
contentPoints: Say which season you like best.
Say what the weather is like.
Say what you do in this season.
task.modelAnswer: My favourite season is spring. In spring the weather is warm and sometimes it rains. Flowers grow in the garden and the trees are green. I like it because it is not too hot or too cold. At the weekend we usually go for a picnic. If it is sunny tomorrow, I will ride my bike with my friends.
